tasks.prompt: From scratch, create a landing page for a neighborhood tool library. Establish a project-owned design system. Help residents understand borrowing and make the primary action Reserve a tool. Do not invent inventory counts, prices, testimonials, or partner logos.

From scratch, create an incident-response dashboard for an on-call engineering team. Establish a project-owned design system. The operator must identify the highest-severity open incident, acknowledge it, and see confirmation. Use clearly labeled sample data and do not imply live infrastructure.

From scratch, create a dense cold-chain exception queue for warehouse operators. Establish a project-owned design system. Operators must filter urgent shipments, inspect one exception, and assign an owner. Label all records as sample data and do not invent regulatory claims.

From scratch, create a three-step onboarding flow for a family caregiver coordination app. Establish a project-owned design system. A user must understand the purpose, choose notification preferences, review the choices, and finish. Do not assume diagnoses, family relationships, or consent.

From scratch, create checkout for a community cooking class. Establish a project-owned design system. The user must review a clearly marked sample booking, enter contact details, see the total, and confirm. Do not invent discounts, scarcity, testimonials, or payment success before confirmation.

From scratch, create a destructive approval screen for deleting a sample research dataset. Establish a project-owned design system. The reviewer must inspect scope, acknowledge consequences, type a confirmation phrase, and approve or cancel. Do not claim real retention, legal, or audit policies.

From scratch, create a public-record search interface using clearly labeled fictional records. Establish a project-owned design system. A user must search, apply two filters, understand result counts, clear filters, and open a record. Do not imply government affiliation or real people.

From scratch, create an editorial field-notes page for an urban ecology collective. Establish a project-owned design system. Readers must understand the article structure, navigate sections, distinguish captions and citations, and subscribe through a validated email field. Do not invent authorship credentials, readership, or sponsors.

From scratch, create a mobile-first form for reporting a fictional transit stop issue. Establish a project-owned design system. The rider must choose an issue type, add optional detail, review the report, and submit it. Do not claim submission to a real transit authority or expose location without consent.

From scratch, create a grant evidence intake workspace for a nonprofit team. Establish a project-owned design system. Users must separate verified evidence, pending claims, and unresolved fields before submitting a draft. Do not fill missing outcomes, budgets, dates, or funder requirements.

From scratch, create a volunteer roster CSV import flow using sample data. Establish a project-owned design system. The coordinator must upload, inspect validation errors, correct or exclude invalid rows, retry, and reach a clear completion state. Do not imply real people were imported.

From scratch, create a clinic visit preparation checklist with locale switching for Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Establish a project-owned design system. A user must switch locale, review fictional preparation items, mark progress, and see completion. Include an honest unavailable-translation state that does not silently change the selected language. Do not provide medical advice or infer a diagnosis.
